===============================================
SAMPLE 20-QUESTION QUIZ URL
===============================================

Copy and paste this URL into your browser to test the quiz feature:

http://localhost:8000/?

===============================================
QUESTIONS IN THIS QUIZ (20 Total)
===============================================

1. What is the capital of France? → Paris
2. What is the capital of Germany? → Berlin
3. What is the capital of Spain? → Madrid
4. What is the capital of Italy? → Rome
5. What is the capital of Poland? → Warsaw
6. What is the capital of Turkey? → Ankara
7. What is the largest planet in our solar system? → Jupiter
8. Who wrote Romeo and Juliet? → William Shakespeare
9. What is the chemical symbol for Gold? → Au
10. What year did the Titanic sink? → 1912
11. What is the smallest country in the world? → Vatican City
12. How many continents are there? → 7
13. What is the highest mountain in the world? → Mount Everest
14. What is the longest river in the world? → Nile
15. In what year did World War II end? → 1945
16. What is the capital of Australia? → Canberra
17. What is the boiling point of water in Celsius? → 100°C
18. Who is the author of 1984? → George Orwell
19. How many sides does a hexagon have? → 6
20. What is the capital of Japan? → Tokyo

===============================================
HOW TO USE
===============================================

1. Make sure the local server is running: python3 -m http.server 8000
2. Copy the URL above
3. Paste it into your browser address bar
4. The quiz will load automatically with all 20 questions
5. The Quiz tab will be the only visible tab (use "📂 Show Tabs" to access others)
6. Click "Reset Quiz" to exit and return to normal mode
